# Test audio

`silence.webm` and `tooshort.webm` are generated by `mkaudio.py` — real
WebM/Opus containers (the exact format `MediaRecorder` produces), holding
silence. They exercise the decode path and the empty/too-short branches without
committing any third-party media.

```bash
docker compose run --rm --entrypoint python3 -v "$PWD/testdata:/out" -w /out stt mkaudio.py
```

Speech samples used for the accuracy and VRAM benchmarks in
[../stt/README.md](../stt/README.md) are **not** committed — they are
third-party media. To reproduce those numbers, fetch them yourself:

- English: `tests/jfk.flac` from the openai/whisper repository.
- Indonesian: "Elis (WMID) Bagian 1 - Indonesia Pada Olimpiade Musim Panas 1952"
  from Wikimedia Commons (spoken Wikipedia, CC licence — check the file page
  for the exact terms before redistributing).

Transcode either to WebM/Opus with PyAV before posting, so the test exercises
the same container the browser sends.
